**Job Overview:** 




 The Software Developer will contribute to the design, development, and maintenance of software applications in collaboration with the IT team. This role involves writing, testing, and debugging code, as well as supporting end users with technical needs. Ideal candidates will have experience with multiple programming languages and a strong foundation in front\-end or back\-end development for UNIX or LINUX environments.
 



 This role reports directly to the VP of Information Technology. Regular responsibilities include contributing ideas and strategies, reviewing plans and progress, evaluating results, and addressing management priorities. THIS IS A ON\-SITE POSITION.

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, MIS, or related field—or equivalent professional experience.

* Experience in front\-end or back\-end development for UNIX or LINUX environments.
* Familiarity with SQL for data manipulation and retrieval.
* Knowledge of database management and security practices (preferred).
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Ability to quickly learn new software and technologies.
